steps.en: Officer searches for a notice by warrant number
steps.id: Officer mencari notice lewat nomor warrant
steps.why_en: The search box exists, but the data behind it cannot be confirmed here.
steps.why_id: Kotak pencarian ada, tetapi data di belakangnya tidak bisa dipastikan di sini.

steps.en: Officer enters warrant number and warrant type
steps.id: Officer mengisi nomor dan tipe warrant
steps.why_en: No screen for entering warrant details exists.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada layar untuk mengisi detail warrant.

steps.en: OCMS saves the updated warrant details on the notice
steps.id: OCMS menyimpan detail warrant yang diupdate pada notice
steps.why_id: Tidak ada yang menyimpan detail warrant.

steps.en: Updated warrant details show correctly on the notice
steps.id: Detail warrant yang diupdate tampil benar pada notice
steps.why_en: Only a read-only warrant number is shown; no type and no update result.
steps.why_id: Hanya nomor warrant read-only yang tampil; tanpa tipe dan hasil update.
